summary: The source contract fixes the board at exactly 9 by 9 cells and the symbol alphabet at nine digits, so no legal workload dimension can scale.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The board always has nine rows of nine cells, and every filled cell is one of nine digits.

replacement_checks.evidence: The implementation visits exactly 81 cells and stores membership in 27 fixed units whose sets each contain at most nine digits.
Regression checks all 3,240 unordered pairs of board positions containing the same digit, plus empty, complete, source, and late-conflict boards against both app-local and immutable native sources.
